category_title: Reluctant stayers who use inappropriate language and avoid academic tasks
minimal_context: The student is in a computer lab working on drafting a persuasive marketing brochure for an assessment.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Please sit at your computer and start drafting your persuasive marketing brochure.

STUDENT: This business proposal is bullshit. It's too hard and completely irrelevant to me. I'm literally only at school so I don't have to be unemployed.

TUTOR: You need to keep working on the assignment.

STUDENT: (Stands up and walks away from the computer) I'm not doing it. I'm going over to the other desks to talk.

TUTOR: Please come back to your desk.

STUDENT: Fuck off, I'm not going back to my desk. I've been in this lab for 70 minutes and I haven't typed a single word of this crap, and I'm not starting now.

options.A: Give the student a simpler task, like drafting a single sentence, if others are drafting the full brochure.
options.B: Provide the student with a choice between two different marketing angles or potential brochure text options.
options.C: Provide computer applications for the drafting task that feature instant rewards with audio and text prompts.
options.D: Remind the student of the assignment's due date and stress the need to complete the brochure to pass.
